data.body_html:
Experience the roar of engines and the sparkle of the Mediterranean from the deck of your private yacht. The F1 Grand Prix 2030 in Marbella is not just a race—it's a lifestyle event. With a yacht charter from Puerto Banús, you skip the crowds, enjoy unlimited drinks and snacks, and watch the action from the best seat in the house: the water. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours, including a skipper, fuel, and VAT. Whether you're a die-hard fan or just here for the atmosphere, this is the ultimate way to celebrate.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for the F1 Grand Prix?

The F1 Grand Prix draws thousands to Marbella, but the most exclusive views are from the sea. A private yacht lets you anchor near the circuit or cruise along the coast, avoiding traffic and packed stands. You get a dedicated skipper, a fully stocked bar, and the freedom to move. Plus, with Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80, you get a free jet ski to add adrenaline to your day.

Best Viewing Spots for the F1 Grand Prix

From the water, you can anchor near Cabopino or Cala del Faro for a panoramic view of the race. These spots offer calm waters and easy access to the circuit. Alternatively, cruise along the Golden Mile and watch from offshore. Your skipper knows the best positions and can adjust based on wind and race schedule.

What's Included in Your Charter

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). No surprises. You can also bring your own food and drinks. For Tier B boats, a jet ski is included free for 4-hour charters.

How to Book Your F1 Grand Prix Yacht Charter

Booking is simple. Visit our main page to browse the fleet, then send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred boat, date, and number of guests. We'll confirm availability and send a quote. For custom packages, we're available 24/7 via WhatsApp.

Tips for a Perfect Grand Prix Day on the Water

  • Book early—boats fill fast for the F1 Grand Prix.
  • Arrive at Puerto Banús 15 minutes before departure.
  • Bring sunscreen, sunglasses, and a hat.
  • Wear comfortable clothing and swimwear.
  • Use the jet ski (if included) between race sessions.
  • Stay hydrated—drinks are included.
